versions.content: DRAFT When receiving a request for UDS Service RoutineCon- trol (0x31) with subfunction stopRoutine, if all verifications have been successfully done (see [SWS_Dcm_00568], [SWS_Dcm_00570], [SWS_Dcm_00571]) and DcmD- spRoutineFncSignature is set to ROUTINE_FNC_PROXY , the Dcm module shall call the configured Xxx_Stop() function passing the routineControlOptionRecord via (see 196 of 709 Document ID 18: AUTOSAR_SWS_DiagnosticCommunicationManager Specification of Diagnostic Communication Manager AUTOSAR CP R21-11 [SWS_Dcm_01614]) and if Xxx_Stop() returned E_OK reply the returned routineSta- tusRecord with a positive response.

DRAFT When receiving a request for UDS Service RoutineCon- trol (0x31) with subfunction stopRoutine, if all verifications have been successfully done (see [SWS_Dcm_00568], [SWS_Dcm_00570], [SWS_Dcm_00571]) and DcmD- spRoutineFncSignature is set to ROUTINE_FNC_PROXY , the Dcm module shall call the configured Xxx_Stop() function passing the routineControlOptionRecord via (see 187 of 689 Document ID 18: AUTOSAR_SWS_DiagnosticCommunicationManager Specification of Diagnostic Communication Manager AUTOSAR CP R22-11 [SWS_Dcm_01614]) and if Xxx_Stop() returned E_OK reply the returned routineSta- tusRecord with a positive response.
